stem_md: 方程 $(y^2+2xy)dx-x^2dy=0$ 的积分因子为（ ）
analysis_md:
$P(x,y)=y^2+2xy,Q(x,y)=-x^2,$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=(2x+2y-(-2x))=4x+2y,
$$

故

$$
-\frac{1}{P}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{2}{y},
$$

则积分因子为

$$
\mu(x,y)=e^{\int -\frac{2}{y}\,dy}=y^{-2},
$$
